s.en: The hotel is next to the sea.
We stayed at a small hotel last spring.
My daughter will book the hotel for us.
s.ko: 제 딸이 우리를 위해 호텔을 예약할 거예요.

s.en: Our room has a view of the mountain.
The room was too cold last night.
They will clean the room this afternoon.
I have a reservation for two nights.
My son made the reservation last week.
I will change my reservation to Friday.
The front desk is open all night.
I left my key at the front desk this morning.
s.ko: 저는 오늘 아침에 열쇠를 프런트에 맡겼어요.

s.en: We will meet in front of the hotel at nine.
s.ko: 우리는 아홉 시에 호텔 앞에서 만날 거예요.

s.en: Reception is on the first floor.
I asked reception for more towels yesterday.
s.ko: 저는 어제 안내 데스크에 수건을 더 달라고 했어요.

s.en: Reception will call a taxi for you.
s.ko: 안내 데스크에서 택시를 불러 줄 거예요.

s.en: We stay at the same hotel every year.
My mother stayed with us for a week last month.
s.ko: 제 어머니가 지난달에 우리 집에 일주일 동안 머물렀어요.

s.en: I am going to stay three nights.
The service at this hotel is very good.
Room service brought our breakfast this morning.
s.ko: 오늘 아침에 룸서비스가 아침 식사를 가져다줬어요.

s.en: The bus service will start again next week.
s.ko: 버스 운행은 다음 주에 다시 시작할 거예요.

s.en: The elevator is next to the front desk.
The elevator was broken all day yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 엘리베이터가 하루 종일 고장 나 있었어요.

s.en: I will take the elevator to the roof.
s.ko: 저는 엘리베이터를 타고 옥상까지 갈 거예요.

s.en: Our room is on a high floor.
We ate breakfast on the first floor this morning.
s.ko: 우리는 오늘 아침에 일 층에서 아침을 먹었어요.

s.en: The cafe on the highest floor will open tomorrow.
s.ko: 가장 높은 층 카페는 내일 열 거예요.

s.en: I always say please at the hotel desk.
Last night I said please and asked for more towels.
s.ko: 어젯밤에 저는 "please"라고 말하고 수건을 더 부탁했어요.

s.en: Will you please call me when the taxi arrives?
